title: 12 Fall Outfit Ideas for Kids, Built From Cozy Basics
description: Twelve fall outfit ideas for kids in rust, navy, forest and cream, plus five basics from listings to build them, each under $30, with one honest limit per pick.
dek: Rust, navy, forest and cream. Twelve looks to browse, five basics to build them.
hook: Kids outgrow things fast, so fall outfits work best as a few repeat pieces: a fleece layer, easy bottoms, a vest and a shoe that goes on quick. Browse the twelve looks first, then pick the basics that fit the ones you like.
We did not test these. We read each listing and use only what it says, so check the size chart and details on the page before you buy.
skipped: Anything where the listing does not say what the item is made of or how it is sized.
Licensed character pieces, since this guide is about plain basics that mix and match.
Anything with no size chart on the listing.
how_picked: Each pick is under the price bracket shown.
The listing says what the item is and how it is cut or sized.
The listing or reviewers give a check or limit worth knowing before you buy.
Specs come from the listing text. Review counts and star ratings are not used here.
final: If you only buy one, make it the fleece hoodie. It layers under the vest and pairs with the jeans and joggers in most looks. Add the vest next, then the joggers.

gallery_intro: Each look uses a short palette and four pieces. The swatches show the colors, and the picks below cover the basics that appear most often.

picks.name: Amazon Essentials Boys and Toddlers' Fleece Pullover Hoodie Sweatshirt
picks.alt: Illustration of a folded blue fleece pullover hoodie with a kangaroo pocket
picks.best_for: A warm layer under a vest or jacket
picks.limit: Reviewers say it runs small, so size up
picks.why: A pullover hoodie in a 56% cotton and 44% polyester brushed-back fleece, with a lined hood, front pockets and rib cuffs and hem.
picks.con: Reviewers say it runs small, so check the size chart and size up if your child is between sizes.

picks.name: Amazon Essentials Girls and Toddlers' Jogger Sweatpants with Elastic Waist and Drawstring
picks.alt: Illustration of folded heather gray fleece jogger sweatpants with a drawstring
picks.limit: Listed as a girls and toddlers cut
picks.why: Tapered-leg joggers in a 56% cotton and 44% polyester brushed-back fleece, with an elastic drawcord waist, rib cuffs and pockets.
picks.con: Listed as a girls and toddlers style, so check the size chart and inseam before you buy.

picks.name: Amazon Essentials Boys and Toddlers' Lightweight Water-Resistant Packable Hooded Puffer Vest
picks.alt: Illustration of a folded black lightweight hooded puffer vest
picks.why: A lightweight, water-resistant hooded puffer vest that packs into its own pouch. Reviewers say it is warm enough for cool fall mornings.
picks.con: Reviewers are mixed on fit and warmth, with some saying it runs small or feels thin, so check sizing and plan a layer under it.

picks.name: Amazon Essentials Girls' Skinny Fit Stretch Jeans
picks.alt: Illustration of folded medium-wash skinny stretch jeans
picks.limit: Skinny fit, not a roomy leg
picks.why: Mid-rise skinny jeans in a stretch cotton blend with five pockets, a zipper with shank button and an internal adjustable waist.
picks.con: Skinny fit, so check the size chart if your child likes a roomier leg.

picks.name: Skechers Unisex-Child Dynamatic Sneaker
picks.alt: Illustration of a pair of black kids hook-and-loop sneakers
picks.why: A black mesh-upper kids sneaker with a cushioned insole, hook-and-loop strap and machine-washable build.
picks.con: Check the size and strap notes on the listing, and measure your child's foot first.
